bath.definition: The act of washing your body in a tub of water.
bath.example: The baby had a warm bath before bed.

bring.definition: To take or carry something to a person or place.
bring.example: Please bring your notebook to class.

brush.definition: A tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting, or arranging hair.
brush.example: She used a brush to fix her hair.

clock.definition: A device that shows the time.
clock.example: The clock on the wall says three o'clock.

cloud.definition: A visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky.
cloud.example: A dark cloud covered the sun.

dream.definition: A series of thoughts or images that happen in your mind while you sleep.
dream.example: I had a funny dream last night.

dress.definition: A one-piece item of clothing that covers the body and usually the legs.
dress.example: She wore a blue dress to the party.

drink.definition: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.
drink.example: Remember to drink water after exercise.

finger.definition: One of the five parts at the end of a hand.
finger.example: He cut his finger on a piece of paper.

floor.definition: The lower surface of a room that you walk on.
floor.example: Your pencil fell on the floor.

glass.definition: A hard, transparent material used to make windows and many containers.
glass.example: The window is made of glass.

grass.definition: A common green plant with narrow leaves that covers many fields and lawns.
grass.example: The dog ran across the grass.

green.definition: The color of grass and many leaves.

happy.example: She felt happy when her friend arrived.

horse.definition: A large four-legged animal that people may ride.
horse.example: The horse ran across the field.

juice.definition: A drink made from the liquid of fruits or vegetables.
juice.example: Would you like orange juice with breakfast?

jump.definition: To push yourself off the ground using your legs.
jump.example: The rabbit can jump over the log.

mouth.definition: The opening in the face used for eating, speaking, and breathing.

pencil.definition: A writing tool with graphite inside a wooden or similar case.
pencil.example: I sharpened my pencil before the test.

plane.definition: An aircraft with wings that flies through the air.
plane.example: Our plane landed safely at the airport.

play.definition: To take part in a game or activity for enjoyment.
play.example: The children play outside after school.

rabbit.definition: A small animal with long ears and strong back legs.

round.definition: Shaped like a circle or ball.

seven.definition: The number that comes after six and before eight.
seven.example: There are seven days in a week.

sheep.definition: A farm animal with a thick woolly coat.

shirt.definition: A piece of clothing worn on the upper body.
shirt.example: He wore a clean white shirt.

short.example: The movie was short but funny.

skirt.definition: A piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and does not separate the legs.
skirt.example: She wore a long skirt to the celebration.

sleep.definition: The natural state of rest when your eyes are closed and your body is inactive.
sleep.example: Most children need plenty of sleep.

small.definition: Little in size, amount, or degree.
small.example: A small bird sat on the fence.

smile.definition: A happy or friendly expression made by turning up the corners of the mouth.
smile.example: Her smile made everyone feel welcome.

snake.example: We saw a small snake near the trail.

sock.definition: A soft piece of clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe.
sock.example: I cannot find my other sock.

spoon.definition: A utensil with a small bowl at the end, used for eating or serving food.
spoon.example: He ate the soup with a spoon.

table.definition: A piece of furniture with a flat top supported by legs.
table.example: The books are on the table.

think.definition: To use your mind to consider or understand something.

tiger.definition: A large wild cat with orange fur and black stripes.
tiger.example: The tiger rested in the shade.

water.definition: A clear liquid that people, animals, and plants need to live.
water.example: Please drink some water after the game.

week.example: We have a science test next week.

winter.definition: The coldest season of the year.
winter.example: We wear warmer clothes in winter.

zebra.definition: An African animal related to the horse, with black-and-white stripes.
zebra.example: The zebra stood beside the watering hole.

zero.definition: The number 0, which means no amount.
zero.example: The temperature fell to zero degrees.
